correctness.rationale: The proof starts from the two exact source root equations. Their difference factors as 2M(2-3r)log(1-r), giving the only possible interior common radius 2/3 and the exact parameter M*=1/[2(log192-1)]. Both roots have positive r-derivative at the root, so implicit differentiation shows strict decrease with M. The sign of the factored difference then gives the global ordering on either side of M*. The endpoint laws follow from exact epsilon equations near r=1 and Taylor expansions near r=0; no finite computation is used to infer the continuum statement.
